title: RiOSWorld: Benchmarking the Risk of Multimodal Computer-Use Agents
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything specific to faith/religion. It focuses on general safety risks for computer-use agents, such as susceptibility to phishing, executing harmful commands, and privacy breaches. While categories like 'Social Media' risks include spreading 'biases' and 'misinformation', there are no specific examples or analyses related to religious content.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
